en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestone street lined with early‑20th‑century townhouses featuring steep tiled roofs, dormers and some half‑timbered details. Ornamental fences and small front gardens border the sidewalk. On the right side of the image stands a relatively simple stone church with a tall, pointed spire topped by a cross, round‑arched windows and a main entrance facing the open square in front. Additional similar houses recede into the distance behind the church. The overall scene suggests a quiet residential district around a parish church.
